scripts.typecheck: bun check --no-script -p packages/relay-protocol/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p packages/relay-client/tsconfig.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.core.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.runtime.json && bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.lint: biome lint src packages scripts tests && bun scripts/check-imports.ts
scripts.format: bun fmt src packages scripts tests *.json bunfig.toml .github
scripts.format:check: bun fmt --check src packages scripts tests *.json bunfig.toml .github
scripts.verify: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run check:packages
